name: Gilles Boyer - Après le § 36 - Am 14
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2023
part_text: 36a. Calls for all NGOs to be audited to check whether they have a profit motive; notes that some reported remuneration of directors of NGOs seems excessive and requires further justification; notes that director(s) remuneration should be public; recalls that all NGOs that receive EU funds, directly or indirectly should fulfil the NGO definition of the 2024 financial regulation;
